risk_flags.reason: scripts/migrate-tighten-description-topic.js performs a DROP TABLE/table-swap on `documents`, a Parent-of-Sacred table that cascades into `questions` and `session_answers`. The migration was actually executed (migration-output.txt shows it ran). With SQLite foreign keys enabled, DROP TABLE documents triggers implicit cascade deletes of dependent sacred rows; even otherwise, the recreated `documents_new` drops all foreign keys and indexes. This is the exact table-swap-as-close-out pattern that destroyed 790 questions and 746 answers on 2026-04-27.

Verification is inadequate and the operation is already run: the script only counts `documents` rows (22→22) and never checks `questions` or `session_answers`, the cascade-dependent sacred tables. Acceptance criterion 2 ('all existing data preserved — no data loss anywhere') is unmet because the dependent graph was not verified. PITR may be needed to assess/restore.

DEC-U06 describes step 6 only as 'tighten documents schema — small, low-risk'; that is descriptive framing, not an enumerated pre-approval for a destructive table-swap with cascade implications on a Parent-of-Sacred table. No specific pre-approval for this exact operation exists in the trusted sections.
